## Wakt 1.0.14

**Pause the website filter for one app, without an escape hatch.** Some banking apps refuse to run while any VPN is active. The website filter card now has a Pause button: pick the app and a duration (5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes). Wakt turns the DNS filter off and at the same time locks the phone to that single app. The filter comes back on its own the moment the lock ends, and immediately if you leave the lock early. Browsers and blocked apps can never be picked, and a pause is refused while another lock is running. A backup alarm restores the filter even if the app is killed mid-pause.

Tip: an app that only complains about the VPN but still works can be excluded permanently under Settings, "Apps Excluded From Website Filter".
